seo.title: Cone Volume Calculator - Hopper Silo
seo.description: Calculate cone, hopper, or conical tank bottom volume from base diameter and height. For silos and material handling.

content.introduction: Calculate the volume of a right circular cone — used for silo bottoms, hopper design, conical tank sections, and material flow calculations. A cone holds exactly 1/3 of the equivalent cylinder.

faq.a: Frustum volume = (πh/3)(R² + Rr + r²) where R and r are the two radii. This calculator handles full cones only.

faq.q: How much angle for mass flow in a hopper?
faq.a: For most bulk solids, a hopper half-angle of 15-20° from vertical ensures mass flow. Steeper for sticky materials.
